species: Nucleosome core particles (NCP), reconstituted from Xenopus laevis histones and 601-DNA, and RNF1681–113 were crosslinked at final concentrations of 15 µM RNF168 and 5 µM NCP in 10 µL volume using a buffer containing 25 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl.
